主要内容: In 2017, the stock market saw a strong performance driven by an investment strategy focused on 'sticking with winners.' This approach, known as long momentum, involved buying shares that were rising the fastest and returned 38 percent, the strongest advance since 1999. The strategy was led by companies such as Square Inc. and Align Technology Inc., which helped it nearly match its performance from the year before the dot-com crash. The year was marked by a rally across various sectors, including chips, Nasdaq, retailers, and banks. This strategy proved to be the most successful in 2017, highlighting the effectiveness of momentum investing in a bull market.
